title: Pipers Nest Vacation Rental
meta_description: Pipers Nest is a 4.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionPIPERS NESTRosemary Beach CommunityEast Long Green Road, Rosemary Beach, FL 32461Home Highlights4 Bedrooms (see “Room Details” tab)3.5 BathroomsSleeps up to 12 Guests2,700+ sq. ft. of indoor spaceFully stocked chef’s kitchen with premium appliancesOpen-concept living & dining areasPrivate walled courtyard with one of the largest pools in Rosemary BeachCirculating spa/hot tub (no jets) — pool and spa cannot be heated simultaneouslyScreened-in second-floor porch overlooking the poolGas grill & multiple outdoor seating areasLaundry room with washer & dryerTwo-vehicle driveway + 1 overflow space (1 community parking pass issued)Four 26” adult bikes included (seasonal: Mar–Nov)Indoor fireplace is decorative onlyNote: Bedrooms are on the ground floor. Pool alarms installed; no pool fence.Luxury Retreat on 30AEscape to Pipers Nest, a stylish 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom vacation home in the heart of Rosemary Beach. This 2,700+ sq. ft. retreat comfortably sleeps up to 12, perfect for families, group getaways, or special celebrations.Designed for Comfort & StyleThe fully equipped chef’s kitchen with premium appliances makes entertaining effortless. Open living and dining areas flow to a screened-in second-floor porch, offering serene views of your private pool and spa within a lush, walled-in courtyard. Multiple outdoor seating areas and a gas grill create the perfect environment for relaxing or entertaining under the Florida sun.Rest & RelaxationFour beautifully appointed bedrooms offer flexible sleeping arrangements. The serene primary suite is ideal for unwinding, while the additional bedrooms and a den with a daybed provide cozy spaces for kids, friends, or quiet reading. An on-site washer and dryer make packing light easy.Outdoor Oasis & Prime LocationEnjoy your private pool and circulating spa, or explore Rosemary Beach on seasonal bikes provided with your stay. Stroll across the street to East Long Green Park, or wander to the beach and Rosemary Town Center with its shops, dining, and coastal charm.Amenities You’ll LovePrivate pool & spa in walled courtyardScreened-in porch overlooking pool & greeneryFully stocked kitchen with premium appliancesGas grill & multiple outdoor seating areasFour adult bikes (seasonal)Washer & dryer, linens providedComfortable accommodations for up to 12Why Pipers Nest?This Rosemary Beach vacation rental blends luxury, privacy, and convenience. Walk to the beach, explore local dining and shops, or simply relax poolside — Pipers Nest is more than a rental, it’s your home base for creating unforgettable memories on Florida’s Emerald Coast.Tip: For multiple homes nearby, check out Costa Verde Cottage.Community AmenitiesFour community pools (some heated seasonally)Private community beach accessRosemary Square: shopping & diningPlayground, parks, and green spacesOutdoor amphitheaterPedestrian paths & lush landscapingFitness center & racquet club (fee-based)Note: Golf carts are prohibited in the community.Pool & Spa HeatingAvailable Oct–Apr for an additional feePool heating only available when outdoor temps are 50°F–80°FPool and spa cannot be heated simultaneouslyParking2 driveway spots + 1 overflow1 community parking pass issuedStreet parking allowed in lined spaces with a valid permitHOA enforces towing & fines strictlyImportant NotesNo pets (service animals allowed with documentation)Homeowners have dogs (may affect those with allergies)No smokingFireplace is decorative onlyMinimum age to rent: 25 yearsBooking & Policies50% due at booking, balance due 60 days priorCancellation >60 days: Refundable minus 5% feeNo full refund once processedTravel insurance available on requestCheck-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CST
